comment: Item names from game.exe data 0x185e (word pointers to strings, 69 entries). Leading % marks a magic-user scroll, & a clerical spell, $ a Disks of Mishakal spell; blank names are unnamed treasure. IDs in items_table.json are 1-based: the name of id N is names[N-1] (Wyrmslayer = id 19, chests 43-46, ids 56-59 are special: women, children, the south door, hidden treasure). (Changes: id 20 is now a Lightning Bolt scroll, id 66 is Detect treasure, ids 70 Flame Tongue +1 and 71 Plate Armor were added.)
